($$;$) {
    package Image::ExifTool;
    use strict;
    (my($valPtr, $format, $count) = @_);
    my(@vals, $val, $n);
    if ((($format eq 'string') or ($format eq 'undef'))) {
        (($count and ($count > 0)) or (return (undef)));
        (my($len) = length($$valPtr));
        if (($format eq 'string')) {
            (($len >= $count) and (return 'String too long'));
        } else {
            (($len > $count) and (return 'Data too long'));
        }
        if (($len < $count)) {
            ($$valPtr .= ("\000" x ($count - $len)));
        }
        (return (undef));
    }
    die('numeric tail must not execute');
}
